# Observed per-step results by seed

Source: `results/per_step/v2/metrics.json`.

Observed additions and deletions count consecutive-step flips, not cumulative flips from y0. Addition precision is added_correct / added. Each R1-R4 share uses that step's total additions as its denominator; the four shares sum to 100% before rounding. All flips are restricted to valid pixels. NA denotes an undefined fraction.

Observed IoU, clDice, BIoU and A are the saved official aggregate scores, with A = quality. Gap repair and new break use the original fixed-y0 skeleton sets. Fraction columns marked % are percentages; metric columns use the 0-1 scale.

JSON locations: seeds.<seed>.<domain>.steps.<t>, with added, deleted, added_correct, regions.<R1-R4>.added, scores.<road_iou|cldice|boundary_iou|quality>, gap_repair and new_break.
